material:
Unit 6 — Our weekend (fragment podręcznika A1, fikcyjny)

Words: play football, read a book, cook dinner, watch TV, jump, sing a song, listen to music, make a cake, write a letter, dance, ride a bike, swim in the lake, run in the park, sit on the sofa, stop at the corner, lie on the grass, tie your shoes.
Nouns: garden, kitchen, bike, lake, park, cake, letter, football, sofa, shoes, grass, song.

Dialogue: Look! Tom is riding his bike in the park. Mum is cooking dinner in the kitchen. The children are swimming in the lake.

Every day: I get up at seven. We play football on Mondays. My dad cooks dinner every day. Anna reads a book in the evening. They usually watch TV after school.

objectives.title: Zdanie twierdzące: I, you, we, they
objectives.descriptionEn: In the present simple, the subjects I, you, we and they use the base form of the verb with no ending (I play, they live).

objectives.title: -s w 3. osobie (he, she, it)
objectives.descriptionEn: In the present simple, the third person singular (he, she, it) adds -s to the base verb (he plays, she works).

objectives.title: Pisownia -es oraz -ies
objectives.descriptionEn: Third person singular adds -es after -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -o (goes, watches), and changes consonant + y to -ies (studies).

objectives.title: Przeczenie: don't / doesn't
objectives.descriptionEn: The present simple negative uses don't for I/you/we/they and doesn't for he/she/it, followed by the base verb (she doesn't play).

objectives.title: Pytanie: Do / Does
objectives.descriptionEn: Present simple questions start with Do (I/you/we/they) or Does (he/she/it) + subject + base verb (Does she play?).

objectives.title: Krótkie odpowiedzi
objectives.descriptionEn: Short answers repeat the auxiliary: Yes, I do / No, I don't; Yes, he does / No, he doesn't.

objectives.title: Forma podstawowa po does / doesn't
objectives.descriptionEn: After does and doesn't the main verb stays in the base form with no -s (she doesn't play, does he play?).
